header.title: GitHub App
header.description: Create and manage the GitHub App used to link apps with GitHub projects and webhooks.

list.title: Configured GitHub Apps
list.emptyDescription: Create a GitHub App to connect SEMOSS apps to GitHub projects.

deleteDialog.title: Remove GitHub App?
deleteDialog.description: Remove "{{appName}}" from this instance? This deletes its stored credentials and project links here. It does not delete the app on GitHub — an owner must remove it there (Settings → Developer settings → GitHub Apps → Advanced).
deleteDialog.openInGithub: Open in GitHub to fully delete

dialog.title: Create GitHub App
dialog.description: Start the GitHub manifest flow to create a new app.
dialog.visibilityHelp: Public apps can be installed on any account or organization. Private apps can only be installed on the account that owns them.

status.notPermitted: You are not permitted to manage GitHub App configuration.

toasts.loadFailed: Failed to load GitHub App configuration.
toasts.notPermitted: You are not permitted to access GitHub App configuration.
toasts.redirecting: Redirecting to GitHub to create the app...
toasts.createSuccess: GitHub App created and configured for this instance.
toasts.createError: Something went wrong creating the GitHub App.
toasts.createErrorConversion: Couldn't create the GitHub App — the exchange with GitHub failed. Please try again.
toasts.createErrorSave: The GitHub App was created on GitHub but couldn't be saved here. Please try again.
toasts.deleteSuccess: Removed the GitHub App from this instance.
toasts.deleteFailed: Failed to remove the GitHub App.

projects.title: Connected projects
projects.empty: No projects are connected to GitHub yet.

branchSelect.label: Branch
branchSelect.errorFallback: Couldn't load branches from GitHub. Retry, or type the branch name.

project.title: GitHub
project.description: Connect this app to a GitHub repository to sync code and receive push updates.
project.syncWarning: Pushes to the tracked branch on GitHub are automatically synced into this project, replacing local changes. The tracked branch is the source of truth.
project.notConnectedDescription: Install the GitHub App on your account or organization and grant it access to the repository you want to link.
project.unavailableTitle: GitHub isn't set up for this instance
project.unavailableDescription: An administrator needs to configure the instance GitHub App before projects can connect.

installation.invalidTitle: GitHub App installation is no longer valid
installation.invalidDescription: The GitHub App was uninstalled or suspended for this repository, so syncing has stopped. Reconnect to restore it.

branchDialog.title: Set tracked branch
branchDialog.description: Only pushes to this branch sync the project. This is usually your default branch (e.g. main).

webhooks.title: Recent webhook activity
webhooks.description: Recent webhook deliveries GitHub sent for this repository. GitHub only retains a short recent window.

changeDialog.title: Change repository
changeDialog.description: Pick a different repository for this project from the ones the installation can access.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect from GitHub?
disconnectDialog.description: This unlinks the project from its repository. It does not uninstall the GitHub App from your account or organization.

picker.manageOnGithub: Can't find your repo? Manage on GitHub
picker.branchHelp: Only pushes to this branch sync the project.

selectRepo.title: Select a repository
selectRepo.description: The installation can access multiple repositories. Choose the one this project should use.
selectRepo.missingInstallation: No installation was provided. Start the connect flow again from the GitHub tab.

toasts.branchFailed: Failed to set the tracked branch.
